name: Leather chest wrap
description: A band of leather scraps stitched together and wrapped round the chest, tied off with a thong. It keeps things in place and covers what it needs to, and little else.
notes: Half rolled as the chest wraps in batch 187 are, 160 mm wide and 450 mm long with its ties: a tan leather roll 90 mm across, a 280 mm loose end with two stitched-on chestnut patches, and two rawhide tie thongs splayed from the end. Slot `bra`, the chest under-layer the bikini top named. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Felt chest wrap
description: A band of felted wool patches stitched together and wrapped round the chest, tied off with a thong. Soft and a little warm.
notes: Rides on `leather_chest_wrap`, the same patched band in a loop; the `finishes` map recolours the band and patches to grey felt. Slot `bra`, as the leather wrap. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Leather corset
description: A stiff black leather corset boned from the bust down over the hips, laced tight up the back. Snug enough to wear under a shirt, and the thick leather turns a glancing cut.
notes: Laid flat, back up, 450 mm across and 360 mm tall: two hourglass halves of black leather with charcoal boning channels and bindings, a laced back panel with steel grommets and crimson laces crossed and tied in a bow at the waist. Laced tight, the back edges meet. Slot `corset` is new: a corset sits between a shirt and a bra, and no existing slot is that layer; `torso` would stop a shirt being worn with it, and `vest` is body armour. The loose state, `loosely_laced_corset`, has its own model; switching between them is a use action yet to be designed. Protection is a judgement for thick leather. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Leather corset (laced loose)
description: The leather corset with its back lacing let out so it fits over clothes. Easier to breathe in.
notes: A distinct state of `corset` with its own model: the back halves 60 mm apart over a charcoal modesty panel, the laces crossing wider and long tails hanging below the bow. Slot `corset`, as the laced state; worn loose it goes over a shirt rather than under it, which one slot cannot order yet. Switching states is a use action yet to be designed. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Waist corset
description: A short black leather corset that cinches the waist from under the bust to the hips, laced tight up the back. It holds the back straight through long days.
notes: Laid flat, back up, 420 mm across and 240 mm tall: an underbust hourglass of black leather with charcoal boning and bindings, steel grommets and crimson laces tied at the waist. Slot `corset` is new: a corset sits between a shirt and a bra, and no existing slot is that layer; `torso` would stop a shirt being worn with it, and `vest` is body armour. The loose state, `loosely_laced_waist_corset`, has its own model. Protection is a judgement. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Waist corset (laced loose)
description: The waist corset with its back lacing let out so it fits over clothes.
notes: A distinct state of `waist_corset` with its own model: the back halves 50 mm apart over a charcoal modesty panel and long lace tails. The trailing lace tails lengthen the box. Slot `corset`, as the laced state. Switching states is a use action yet to be designed. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Garter belt
description: A narrow black cotton belt trimmed with lace, worn round the hips under clothes, with four elastic straps that clip to the tops of stockings.
notes: Laid flat, 300 mm across and 320 mm long with its straps: a shaped black waistband with black lace along both edges, a pink bow at the front, steel hook-and-eye ends, and four black suspender straps with steel sliders and clips with pink rubber buttons. Slot `garters` is new: it sits round the hips under briefs and trousers alongside a belt, so neither `waist`, `briefs` nor `belly` fits. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Leg warmers
description: A pair of soft knit tubes pulled over the calves, pink with cream stripes and ribbed at both ends. Warmer than they look.
notes: Laid flat side by side, 250 mm across and 420 mm long: two pink knit tubes 110 mm across with crimson-ribbed cuffs at both ends, gathers across the slouched middle and two cream stripes round each. Slot `overlegs`, the layer chaps take over trousers; they cover the lower legs only, which one slot cannot say yet. Large and small sizes ride on this model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Fur leggings
description: A pair of sleeves of fur-on hide tied round the legs with rawhide thongs. Crude, and very warm.
notes: Laid flat side by side, 420 mm across with their ties and 440 mm long: two brown fur sleeves 130 mm across at the ankle widening to 160 mm, broad low mounds of pile over the face and three rawhide thongs wrapped flat round each, their ends lying on the floor. Slot `overlegs`, as the knit leg warmers. The small size, `fur_leggings_small`, rides on this model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Fur leggings (small)
description: A small pair of sleeves of fur-on hide tied round the legs with rawhide thongs. Crude, and very warm.
notes: A small size of `fur_leggings`, which it rides on. Slot `overlegs`, as the full size. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hoof furs
description: A pair of short, flared fur sleeves that tie on above the hooves, for feet no boot will fit.
notes: Laid flat side by side with a gap between, 470 mm across with their ties and 220 mm long: two pale fur sleeves flaring from 140 mm at the top to 190 mm round the hoof, broad low mounds of pile over the face and one rawhide thong wrapped flat at the top of each. Slot `feet`: they cover the feet of a hoofed wearer who cannot wear shoes. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Long underwear bottoms
description: Close-fitting cream cotton long johns in a waffle knit, with an elastic waist and ribbed ankle cuffs, made to wear under trousers in the cold.
notes: Folded on a shelf, waistband at +z, 280 mm by 300 mm and 48 mm tall: cream cotton with a lattice of waffle-knit lines, a cream elastic waistband, a fly seam and the ribbed ankle cuffs folded up over the top. Slot `underlegs` is new: `legs` would stop trousers being worn over it, and `briefs` would stop underwear. No pockets. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Long underwear top
description: A close-fitting cream cotton top in a waffle knit with long sleeves, a ribbed crew neck and three buttons at the throat, made to wear under a shirt in the cold.
notes: Folded on a shelf, neck at +z, 300 mm by 320 mm and 48 mm tall: cream cotton with a lattice of waffle-knit lines, a ribbed crew-neck ring, a short placket with three pearl buttons and the sleeves folded down both sides to ribbed cuffs, on `g.jacket`. Slot `undershirt` is new: `torso` would stop a shirt being worn over it; it should also cover the arms once a slot can cover more than one region. No pockets. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Sleeveless undershirt
description: A close-fitting grey cotton vest in a fine rib with a scoop neck and narrow shoulders, made to wear under a shirt.
notes: Folded on a shelf, neck at +z, 280 mm by 300 mm and 32 mm tall: heather grey cotton with fine ribbing down the lower half, a cream-bound scoop neck over a dark opening and cream-bound armholes cut in at both sides. Slot `undershirt`, as the long-sleeved top. No pockets. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Panties
description: Plain cream cotton underwear with pink trim and a small bow at the waistband.
notes: Laid flat, waist at -z, 300 mm across and 200 mm long: a cream front panel curving in to the crotch gusset, a pink elastic waistband, pink picot trim round the leg openings and a small pink bow at the front. Slot `briefs`, as the bikini bottoms. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
